title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in AdvancedCoding…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the wpDiscuz plugin for WordPress, affecting versions up to 7.6.75. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
